title: Quick Fix Spanish Basque Chinese Long Beans Tapas Platter
description: A salty, flaky tapas platter featuring katsuramuki-cut Chinese long beans, ideal for a quick fix snack or light meal. This dish is egg-free and suitable for a variety of diets.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and swirl to coat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 1 pound of katsuramuki-cut Chinese long beans to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until slightly tender.
Sprinkle with smoked paprika and cook for an additional minute.
Add 1/4 cup of diced Basque-style chorizo to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Toss the long beans with salt to taste, then transfer to a serving platter.
Top the long beans with crumbled Manchego cheese and a sprinkle of garlic powder.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips and lemon wedges on the side, garnished with fresh parsley.
Garnish with additional smoked paprika if desired.
